name: Duty or tax or fee category code
source: UNTDID 5305 as restricted by EN 16931-1 for BT-95 / BT-102 / BT-151
notes: The only list in this directory marked complete. EN 16931 restricts UNTDID 5305 to these nine category codes, and that restriction IS the list — it is closed, not a subset we happen to hold. This is what backs the one fail-severity code list rule in the M0 ruleset (tax_category_unmapped). Verify against the published EN 16931-1 code list annex before first client use; a tenth code appearing here would mean a spec revision, not a data-entry gap.
